card.name: Dose word right after an amount
card.fires_on: The word dose or doses, or the /day ending, directly after a quantity such as mg, mg/kg or divided. It appears in dosing and overdose passages.

modes.label: Dose or doses after mg
modes.description: The word dose or doses follows an amount in mg or the phrase divided.

modes.label: /day after mg/kg
modes.description: The /day ending completes a per-weight daily amount.
